To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce hierarchical deep convolutional neural network (HD CNN) by embedding deep convolutional neural (CNN) into a two level hierarchical category classifier.
(1) HD CNNs are scalable to large-scale visual recognition, (2) HD CNNs can achieve better accuracy than standard CNNs on CIFAR100 and ImageNet 100 datasets.
we propose a new deep CNN architecture that is able to achieve superior results on large scale image classification benchmarks by leveraging the hierarchical structure of object categories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two aspects of deep CNNs.

the problem of large-scale image classification, where we are faced with the problem that there are too many categories to distinguish, which is difficult for the existing deep convolutional networks.
the problem of large-scale visual recognition, where the visual separability between categories is highly uneven.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our HD CNNs are able to achieve better accuracy and lower error rate than standard CNNs on both CIFAR 100 and ImageNet datasets.
HD CNNs are a new and powerful architecture that can improve the performance of deep CNNs on large scale visual recognition.
HD CNNs are a promising approach to large scale visual recognition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hierarchical deep CNNs are a better way to train a deep CNN than a flat one.
we have introduced a novel hierarchical deep CNN architecture, and have demonstrated the benefits of the hierarchical structure for large scale visual recognition.
we have developed a hierarchical deep convolutional neural network for large scale visual recognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
HD CNNs can be trained in a principled way to achieve better performance on large scale visual recognition.
HD CNNs provide a new way to build large scale CNNs for visual recognition, and the proposed HD CNNs can be easily extended to multi level category hierarchies.
